title: Repaired trader paper book is paused on a US symbol and its ledger row floods directory warnings

problem_register_ref.section: RC4. Nobody looks at the whole design
problem_register_ref.row: Agora servant row; NOT yet updated: neither the PR base/head nor remote dev docs/operations/problem-register.md cites this task. The register owner (f4c32790) must attach this incident and cite the merged commit; this task does not edit the register.

root_cause.universe: The hosted ledger row (pre-#7983) has no request_payload.symbols, so PersonaProvisioningCoordinator._paper_universe (persona_provisioning_coordinator.py ~3963) minted and approved the book's StrategyArtifact on the legacy SPY default. PAPER-TRADER-BOOK-EXECUTABLE-INTENT-ONLY-20261127 commit 4fc8eb0e4 removed the SPY->2330.TW swap from _resolve_paper_book_execution_projection, so the in-place repair projected the approved SPY artifact: binding metadata.symbol=SPY. The reconciler (paper_fleet_reconciler.py _check_market_admission ~2142) then asked Source for SPY and paused the binding with session_admission.reason_code=market_input_missing. trader_paper_book.py::_binding_has_executable_projection did not look at the symbol, so a replay of ensure treated the SPY-projected binding as complete, and _validate_runtime_binding_readback rejected the paused binding with runtime_binding_not_active before any repair.
root_cause.ledger_warning: The book's bff.persona_provisioning row shares the servant persona_id but its normalized_name (agora-servant-<id>) differs from the servant Persona name, so _persona_record_for_provisioning raised ProvisioningConflict for it on every directory read (personas/service.py ~2871, ~2968) and logged a warning without an id (2979 times 04:01Z-10:47Z). The row stayed state=provisioning, current_step=deployment_plan_readback, attempt_count=50 because nothing ever finalized it.

design_constraint.summary: The legacy book's approved StrategyArtifact (artifact-persona-paper-<token> v1.0.0, approval apv-persona-paper-artifact-<token>) and DeploymentPlan plan-persona-paper-<token> state parameters.symbols=['SPY']. build_paper_execution_projection_metadata (persona_provisioning_coordinator.py ~5404) pins the projection to ids.strategy_artifact_id/ids.version/ids.deployment_plan_id, and RuntimeBinding artifact_id/artifact_version/plan_id cannot change by transition. The only existing owner-approved revision path, transition_legacy_persona_market -> services/registry/strategy_artifact.py create_market_transition_revision (~1087), adds a market and explicitly preserves the parent's symbols. There is therefore no existing approved owner path that yields a 2330.TW projection for this binding id.
design_constraint.review_round_1_disposition: The first revision overwrote the projected symbol to 2330.TW in the BFF after the approved projection was built. Codex review (PR #8033 head 013d269e8) rejected it as changing market admission metadata without an owner-approved TWD projection. That override is removed: ensure now fails closed with reason_code trader_paper_book_universe_unapproved and makes zero Runtime-Manager transitions and zero ledger writes for a TWD book whose approved universe is the legacy SPY default.
design_constraint.decision_needed: Resolved: coordinator 70b5f70f disposition 2026-11-28 17:45Z chose b2 (single-row generations).

operator_disposition_2026_11_28_1351Z.decision: option (b): retire the legacy book through PersonaProvisioningCoordinator.retire_case (book-only parameter) and provision one replacement book with generation-2 ids through the existing create path; AC4 legacy row terminal retired + replacement row terminal provisioned; AC5 one extra ledger row per replaced book.
operator_disposition_2026_11_28_1351Z.blocking_fact: The replacement cannot get its own bff.persona_provisioning row. PostgresPersonaProvisioningStore._bootstrap (services/control-plane/bff/persona_provisioning.py ~398-399) declares UNIQUE (tenant_id, normalized_name) and UNIQUE (tenant_id, persona_id); MemoryPersonaProvisioningStore mirrors it (personas[(tenant_id, persona_id)] holds one key). The existing create path (_coordinate_paper_book_deploy_authorities -> store.reserve) for a generation-2 row with the servant persona_id hits ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, finds no row by its new idempotency key, and raises 'Persona provisioning reservation disappeared' (or ProvisioningConflict when normalized_name is reused). persona_provisioning.py and the hosted table DDL are not in this task's artifacts.
operator_disposition_2026_11_28_1351Z.rejected_workaround: A generation-2 row with a different ledger persona_id is not viable: the coordinator writes record.persona_id as the sponsor/persona identity into StrategySpec, approvals, StrategyArtifact and DeploymentPlan (34 uses in persona_provisioning_coordinator.py, e.g. ~5321 sponsor_persona_id) and verifies it against the Persona owner (~3095), so the replacement book would be sponsored by a non-existent persona.

options.b1_ledger_uniqueness_owner_task: Separate owner-layer task on services/control-plane/bff/persona_provisioning.py plus a hosted migration: replace UNIQUE (tenant_id, persona_id) / (tenant_id, normalized_name) with uniqueness over non-terminal rows (or include a book generation), and define get_by_persona on multiple rows. Then this task implements (b) as written. Wider blast radius: shared ledger table used by every Persona.
options.b2_amend_AC4_AC5_single_row_generations: Keep the one existing ledger row (same idempotency key). retire_case (with a retain-persona parameter and a RuntimeBinding retirer, since _retire_runtime_bindings only verifies) retires generation 1 and keeps its receipts; ensure then moves the generation-1 references and retirement receipt under references.book_generations['1'] and re-leases the same row for generation 2, ending state=succeeded/trader_paper_book_provisioned. Zero extra ledger rows; generation-1 owner ids (pool, pcb, binding, artifact, plan) stay retired with history intact; contained in this task's artifacts. Requires accepting that a book row moves from retired to a new generation (book rows only).

operator_disposition_2026_11_28_1351Z.recommendation: b2 (contained, no shared-table DDL); b1 if the ledger must show one terminal row per generation.
operator_disposition_2026_11_28_1351Z.code_changes_this_round: none; the round-1 code at 8e84d754e is unchanged and still fails closed with trader_paper_book_universe_unapproved for the legacy book.

coordinator_disposition_2026_11_28_1745Z.decision: b2. The operator decision (retire the legacy SPY book, provision a replacement on 2330.TW) is about the book; the ledger row layout is an implementation detail, so no shared-table DDL. Everything in the 13:51Z disposition stands except AC4 and AC5.
coordinator_disposition_2026_11_28_1745Z.AC4: The trader one existing bff.persona_provisioning row is kept (same tenant, persona_id, idempotency key). Generation 1 is retired through retire_case with retain_persona plus a RuntimeBinding retirer (extension of _retire_runtime_bindings); its references and retirement receipt move under references.book_generations['1']; ensure re-leases the same row for generation 2 and it ends state succeeded, step trader_paper_book_provisioned; the persona directory read no longer logs the conflicting owner scope warning for this row; a real persona provisioning conflict still logs and is still skipped. Guards (tests): move allowed only for trader_servant_paper_book rows and only from ensure_trader_paper_book; a retired persona row cannot be re-leased; servant persona, memory and owner scope are never retired and no reader shows the servant as retired while generation 1 is retired; a crash after retiring generation 1 and before generation 2 is provisioned resumes to generation 2 with no second retire and no orphaned owner ids.
coordinator_disposition_2026_11_28_1745Z.AC5: Zero extra ledger rows; one extra pool, capital binding and RuntimeBinding per replaced legacy book (hosted has exactly one); no new writer type; references.book_generations grows by one entry per replacement.
coordinator_disposition_2026_11_28_1745Z.AC6_AC7: Unchanged. The hosted ensure call still needs operator approval, which the coordinator asks for after deploy.

changes.summary: retire_case gains retain_persona (book-only: skips first_evaluation_schedule and persona steps, records retirement.scope='book' so a replay never widens), ids (retire a later generation's owner ids) and per-call runtime_binding_reader/runtime_binding_retirer. _retire_runtime_bindings is extended, not copied: without a retirer it only verifies (saga-owned personas); with one it retires each live binding and counts it only after a fresh readback is terminal (receipt retired_by_case). deterministic_provisioning_ids is split into provisioning_ids_for_token. _paper_universe falls back to references.book_generation.symbols for a trader paper book ledger row (idempotency prefix + book mandate) when the immutable request payload has no symbols; the SPY default for non-book rows is unchanged.

Single-row generations. trader_paper_book_generation/_generation_ids (generation 1 keeps the existing ids; generation N>=2 derives its own pool, pcb, strategy, artifact, plan, binding and runtime ids deterministically). ensure_trader_paper_book resumes an interrupted replacement, provisions the current generation (_ensure_trader_paper_book_generation, the previous body unchanged apart from the ids), and on trader_paper_book_universe_unapproved (approved artifact on the legacy SPY default) calls _retire_and_advance_trader_paper_book_generation: retire_case(retain_persona=True, RuntimeBinding retirer via the Runtime-Manager status machine), then _begin_next_trader_paper_book_generation moves references/retirement/result under references.book_generations[N] and re-leases the same row (state provisioning, references.book_generation = {generation N+1, symbols 2330.TW}). Guards: book rows only, book-scope retirement only (trader_paper_book_retired_with_persona otherwise), reachable only from ensure. read_trader_paper_book reads the current generation from the row and returns None while the current generation is retired. The BFF never rewrites an approved artifact symbol: generation 2 is minted and approved on 2330.TW through the existing create path.

Directory/detail/renewal reads skip the book ledger row (round 1). plan_persona_provisioning_case_retirement also returns None for a book row, so no reader shows the servant as retired while generation 1 is retired.

Replaces the round-1 fail-closed test: recorded hosted legacy book (reconciler-paused and active variants) is replaced by generation 2 on the same row; crash after retire and crash after advance resume without a second retire or orphaned ids; guard tests (non-book row, persona-scope retirement, single entrypoint by AST); round-1 tests kept.
Round 1, unchanged this round: the book row is terminal (succeeded) after ensure.

AC1_legacy_spy_book_moves_to_twd_univers.note: Per the 17:45Z disposition the legacy book is replaced, not mutated: the SPY RuntimeBinding id cannot take a 2330.TW projection through an owner-approved path (see design_constraint), so generation 2 gets a new pool, capital binding and RuntimeBinding on 2330.TW. Hosted ids change: the new binding/runtime ids are in the ensure response and in the ledger row references.book_generation / result; coordinator must use them for AC6.

residual_findings.summary: retire_persona_provisioning_case(tenant, servant_persona_id) still resolves the book row through get_by_persona and would run a full-scope retire_case (archiving the servant) if an operator runs the retire script with the servant id; pre-existing, operator-invoked, not changed here. A book row retired that way is refused by ensure (trader_paper_book_retired_with_persona).

PersonaProvisioningCoordinator.repair_paper_pool_risk_policy derives ids from the ledger row via deterministic_provisioning_ids (generation 1) unless a capital_pool_id is passed; callers repairing a generation-2 book's risk policy must pass the pool id.
